mapper.select: SELECT record_id as recordId, session_id as sessionId, name as name, email as email, ip_address as ipAddress, join_time as joinTime, leave_time as leaveTime FROM attendance_record WHERE record_id = #{recordId}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.attendance.selectListAttendance */ ar.record_id as recordId, ar.session_id as sessionId, s.name as sessionName, s.using_dept as sessionDept, DATE_FORMAT(s.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as sessionStartTime, s.invite_link as sessionInviteLink, DATE_FORMAT(s.link_expiry, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as sessionLinkExpiry, ar.name, ar.email, COALESCE(ar.ip_address, '') as ipAddress, DATE_FORMAT(ar.join_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as joinTime, CASE WHEN ar.leave_time IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(ar.leave_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') ELSE '진행중' END as leaveTime, CASE WHEN ar.leave_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, ar.join_time, ar.leave_time) ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, ar.join_time, NOW()) END as participationMinutes, CASE WHEN ar.leave_time IS NULL THEN '참여중' ELSE '퇴장완료' END as status FROM attendance_record ar INNER JOIN session s ON ar.session_id = s.session_id
AND ar.session_id = #{scSessionId}
AND ar.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{scName}, '%')
AND ar.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{scEmail}, '%')
AND DATE(ar.join_time) = STR_TO_DATE(#{scJoinTime}, '%Y%m%d')
ORDER BY ar.join_time
ASC
DESC
LIMIT #{startRow}, #{pageSize}

SELECT record_id as recordId, session_id as sessionId, name, email, COALESCE(ip_address, '') as ipAddress, DATE_FORMAT(join_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as joinTime, CASE WHEN leave_time IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(leave_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') ELSE '진행중' END as leaveTime, CASE WHEN leave_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, join_time, leave_time) ELSE '-' END as participationMinutes, CASE WHEN leave_time IS NULL THEN '참여중' ELSE '퇴장완료' END as status FROM attendance_record
AND session_id = #{scSessionId}
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{scName}, '%')
AND email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{scEmail}, '%')
AND DATE(join_time) = #{scJoinTime}
ORDER BY join_time
ASC
DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN leave_time IS NULL THEN 1 END) as activeCount FROM attendance_record WHERE 1=1
AND session_id = #{scSessionId}
